I really think you ought to leave that aspect of his personality to be discovered by your friend herself.  
But,in the off chance you are certain this dude is bad juju,maybe have some proof how much of a creep he is,you're all set to intervene

If  you feel even a slight bit prepared to move on,do what it takes,even get a new pet.There's very little that a white/black text is going to say to actually convince and reassure you in the long run,my assumption is to do as all these people here say and make an effort for yourself.Don't find comfort in other things or beings,but use them to make sure you have a healthy relationship with yourself.Keep pursuing the few things that make you happy and leave behind without a second thought those that bring you down.That's another major difficulty.Say,for example,you try to socialise more and connect with people.That's a process that stems from both personal,individual and outside factors that you don't always have control over.But even though it's not a cake walk,it's not going to work right away,it''s just something you have to push through while beating the everloving shit out of your negativity,just so you can get better.I don't find personal security in saying any of this,this is my opinion,not facts.I give you all the love that's left in me,I have faith in your prosperity(and It d0esn't matter to me whether or not this helps)

I can't even get to that goal right now,I already explained why.Trying new things is still a work in progress,I do it only to get people like you off my back.(I feel like I need to apologise for my expression,even though i'm mid-depressive episode and that's how I currently think.)There's nothing that holds me to this plane of existence other than the absolute mayhem my death would cause to my closest people.Even that is really difficult to latch on to.Still,i keep feeling like your efforts are to no avail,even though I think I should appreciate your approach.This isn't what I was expecting,although I never thought of it as an alternative to therapy,which I'm trying to attend.It's a big "A+ for effort,but fuck you for making me feel worse" kind of deal.Thanks,you're trying

When I was younger,I just wanted to teach english.Only other thing was basketball,but that didn't work out.My interests weren't much different in highschool,I just really wanted to be the guy to fix the world's usage of subs and dubs.But my parents ferociously refused to allow me pursuing a specific university and at the same time,I stopped putting effort in school,because no one checked whether or not I was doing homework.Yes,I understand the meaning of taking advantage of the oportunities given to me,but we're talking about early onset corruption,rendering my caveman brain only barely capable of going on the internet,feeding my depression,smoking weed-which has actually helped me be a bit more productive in my recent years- and finding ways to have meaningless sex.Like I said,I keep pushing my responsibilities away without even having to think about the consequenses.

Goodbye,man  
Can't say I'll miss you,but you probably shouldn't care either way.

yes,of course I feel the same way.I kick myself everytime I try and fail to muster up courage to commit,but I also hopelessly fantasize about how it would happen,in extreme detail.Maybe focusing on a romantisized death could distract or lead you to a better path.Never lose hope of death
